final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT L.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(1.0 * L.HGB / NULLIF(L.HCT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM step1) SELECT step1.ID, step1.SEX, step1.avg_wbc, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg_ratio AS ratio_delta FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg_ratio ORDER BY ratio_delta DESC LIMIT 10
